column1: Supplementary Table S7. Sensitivity of the three-cluster SNF solution to parameter settings
Notes: The default SNF parameters were K = 20, sigma = 0.5, and T = 20. Each alternative setting changed one parameter at a time while the other parameters were held at their default values.
ARI, NMI, and agreement compare each three-cluster solution with the default full-data partition after optimal label matching. Changed patients are those not retaining the reference subphenotype.
ARI, adjusted Rand index; NMI, normalized mutual information; SNF, similarity network fusion.
